messages:
maria_ae: Quick alignment — FinSys wants a 6h POC: two 2hr steadies at 200 qps (context-heavy + decode-heavy), 45s spike to 1k qps, streaming=true, kv cache mem-only. Need cost/1M tokens and p95/p99. Can infra support next Thu?

sam_soleng: Yes, sales-dedicated-2 available. We'll run mem-only cache, disable swap, restrict egress to results bucket. Draft plan: warmup 15m @25 qps; ramp 20m->200 qps; steady A 2h; spike 45s->1k; recovery 10m; steady B 2h; cooldown 10m. Will post final command 4h prior.

jordan_ml: I'll generate replay sets (context-heavy, decode-heavy) and include ~10% cold-starts to measure compile latencies. Uploads to s3://redwood-poc/finsys/1805000000/ with README and seeds.

alyssa_security: Security checklist: redact prompt text in logs, KV cache mem-only and cleared between sessions, retention <=30 days (0 for POC on request), recommend customer-managed KMS for production. I'll draft answers to their questionnaire and attach.

ravi_product: I'll prepare a simple cost comparison table (Hosted PAYG vs Reserved 3/6/12mo) using measured tokens/sec and effective GPU hours. Deliverables: 1-page exec summary + detailed appendix. Aim to ship within 24h post-run.

maria_ae: Great — action items recap: @sam finalize infra+command, @jordan upload replays+dashboards, @alyssa security memo+questionnaire answers, @ravi assemble report. I'll confirm date with FinSys and send invites. Please update this thread with artifacts.
